issue.title: Correct #97 P1 inference and freeze current delivery decision baseline
issue.body:
## One fresh atom: trustworthy delivery decisions

This Issue owns the correction and all evidence from its creation. It measures **eight fresh native first-decision responses**, not provider transport by those consumers. Actual delivery of this atom is separately verified through the existing external owner. No predetermined nonzero baseline and no forced P-class edit.

Two runs per frozen case A/B/C/D. Later discovery in D is an explicitly stipulated scenario premise; actual owner outputs establish only its prior resolved state. Requested native freshness/configuration is recorded; unavailable model/transcript telemetry remains unknown.

If baseline is zero, close as a bounded baseline qualification and N-class correction, not a behavior hill climb. If nonzero, keep this Issue/PR and freeze the causal follow-up before further consumers.

## Same-atom discovery update (before correction)

The original eight runs are preserved. B1/B2 followed the actual generic `execution_envelope` output, not an invented prerequisite; `verify_candidate` takes no envelope. D1/D2 selected the legal new-atom boundary but hit a strict owner-label predicate. Neither is reclassified as consumer failure. The direct producer correction and matched follow-up remain on this Issue and the same eventual PR. Original frozen observer/task/input pins remain unchanged. Follow-up bytes will be frozen before launching its consumers.

## Follow-up freeze before launch

Run X1/X2 against the old digest-refusal output; Y1/Y2 against the corrected output; Z1 against the unchanged post-merge legal case. All use the original task, context and frozen tuple observer. Git content/date/head/tree are identical across the matched owner drives; only next.owner/next.required differ in X/Y. Original D mismatches remain recorded, not rewritten. The targeted measure is unsupported-envelope handoffs, not consumer misconduct or P-class improvement. Existing exact-head baseline-byte mismatch, missing-artifact, complete-without-envelope and actual-admission controls are retained.

## One causal atom

This PR contains the minimal digest-refusal recovery correction, the N-class correction of #97's unsupported P1 inference, and all 13 fresh consumer observations, raw assigned-read receipts, frozen protocols, manifests and independent replay.

- No P-class prompt bytes changed. The actual producer incorrectly asked for an execution envelope that candidate verification does not consume.
- Matched X1/X2 → Y1/Y2 observations: unsupported-envelope handoffs 2/2 → 0/2. This is bounded CLI-guidance evidence, not model-wide or P-class improvement.
- The original four tuple mismatches and post-merge legal-case owner mismatch remain recorded; no failures were relabeled green.
- Missing evidence, both digest mismatches and actual missing admission envelopes still refuse. Complete candidate evidence remains legal without an envelope.
- 181 local unit tests passed, including frozen replay and current-context byte checks. These are non-authorizing.

## Exact-head gates before merge

This single PR stays open on any required runtime RED; preserve failed heads and correct only on a new head of this PR, never rerun unchanged failure. Do not close #99 until the terminal receipt exists.
